chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Validity Period of RCMC
text: 2.81 Validity Period of RCMC RCMC shall be deemed to be valid from 1st April of licensing year in which it was issued and shall be valid for five years ending 31st March of the licensing year, unless otherwise specified.
intent: Support Validity Period of RCMC processing and compliance validation.
